prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic square ecommerce catalog image for Home Gym Creator.
Primary request: Flex Studio Dumbbells — a colorful set of lightweight studio dumbbells.
Subject: Exactly SIX small fixed-weight dumbbells, arranged as THREE matching pairs. Smallest pair in soft coral pink, medium pair in muted sage green, largest pair in dusty sky blue. Each pair consists of two identical dumbbells of the same color and size. Each dumbbell has two compact rounded hexagonal ends joined by a short comfortable subtly waisted grip, all fully coated in the same matte finely textured neoprene-like rubber. Gently increasing size across the three pairs, recognizable light studio fitness weights rather than bulky bodybuilding weights. Realistic manufacturing details and restrained surface grain, original unbranded generic design.
Scene/backdrop: warm off-white seamless studio background and floor, consistent with premium home-gym catalog photography. No room or props.
Composition: slightly elevated front three-quarter view, six dumbbells lying naturally on their flat hex ends in a neat compact display of three staggered rows, coral pair nearest the camera, sage pair in the middle, blue pair behind. Each row contains two distinct complete dumbbells with clear separation. Slight graceful diagonal orientation, all six handles and all twelve heads legible without merging or excessive occlusion. Center the whole group, fill about 75 percent of the square canvas with comfortable margins. No rack, stand or packaging.
Lighting: soft broad studio key light, delicate shadows touching the floor beneath each weight, realistic gentle highlights showing matte coating; crisp product detail and natural tonal depth.
Style: convincing real commercial product photograph, not illustration, not plastic toy, not simplified CGI. Tasteful cheerful colors with accurate material texture.
Avoid: extra or missing dumbbells, mismatched pairs, extra heads or handles, floating or interpenetrating objects, shiny chrome grips, adjustable plates, visible metal, racks, people, hands, text, numbers, weight labels, brand logos, watermarks, exercise diagrams. No medical claims. Generate one image.
review: Visually inspected: six complete dumbbells in three matching pairs, coral/sage/blue, rounded hex heads and full matte textured coating. Warm off-white studio backdrop; no branding, labels or rack. Photo is appearance reference only; arrangement does not define the product planning footprint.
